ideas.title: Publish the month's fixtures in one graphic
ideas.desc: A single calendar or matchday poster that fans can save and check all month. Build the template once and reuse it.

ideas.title: Make tickets and kit drops part of the matchday story
ideas.desc: One bold line, one clear action, no price list. The sales post feels like content, not an ad.

ideas.title: Show the first day back in training
ideas.desc: When players return from national teams, film the first session. No script, just the reunion.

ideas.title: Turn one number into the hook
ideas.desc: Pick one figure from the month, such as passes or career goals, and make it the first thing viewers see.
tags: Easy to adapt to any sport

ideas.title: Share a fan moment
ideas.desc: Ask permission, credit the fan who filmed it and add one line. The crowd becomes your content.

ideas.title: Mark a milestone or say thanks
ideas.desc: Count down to a record, a farewell or an anniversary. Plan it before the date and let emotion carry the post.
